title: Large Language Models Polarize Ideologically but Moderate Affectively in Online Political Discourse

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the political slant of Reddit comments on a continuous scale from liberal to conservative using a bag-of-words method mapped to keyword frequencies from 2021 congressional speeches, and evaluating changes in user polarization using difference-in-differences regressions.

Analyzing paired original threads and subsequent replies to evaluate if ChatGPT-generated comments systematically echo and align with the political stance of the content they are responding to, regardless of the user's baseline ideology.
